11.text: Forter became a launch partner for Salesforce’s AI-first Storefront Next and extended protection to Salesforce Loyalty Management. The other articles cover unrelated funding, product, hiring, and office news with no meaningful Salesforce bearing.

9.text: Oppenheimer maintained its Outperform rating and $275 price target on Salesforce after a survey found 85% of customers have tried Agentforce, though the firm noted one missing element.

7.text: Software stocks rebounded in Q3 2026, with the iShares software ETF up 17% while semiconductors fell 11%, as AI fears proved overblown. Salesforce was named among leaders of that comeback, and it rose with peers after Accenture's strong earnings beat.

4.text: Salesforce stock is down from its September high, trades well below its 2024 peak, and has underperformed the market recently despite new AI deals and estimates holding steady. The company authorized a $50 billion buyback in February 2026 and executed half within weeks, while articles debate its cash flow, long-term returns, and valuation versus peers.

12.text: Salesforce is not mentioned in these articles, which focus on Microsoft's AI-driven stock surge and an ETF overview.

5.text: Salesforce is expanding AI bundles combining Agentforce, Slack, and Data 360 to drive adoption and recurring revenue. Agentforce ARR hit $1.5 billion in Q2, up 240% year-over-year.
